name: Acetonitrile
about: Points sampled from the source of each property record (or the source's own tabulated values) by validation/python/fit_properties.py. test/properties.test.js checks that the coefficients in src/data/components.json reproduce them within the maximum deviation stated in each record.

source.fit: ChemSep equation 105 coefficients taken over unchanged except: A converted from kmol/m3 to kg/m3 with the ChemSep molar mass 41.0519 kg/kmol.; reproduces ChemSep within 0.0001 % at 200 points 229.32-545.50 K

source.name: measured vapour pressures (NIST TRC ThermoML Archive) and the critical point
source.fit: Fitted to measured vapour pressures (NIST TRC ThermoML Archive): 148 values with stated uncertainties within 1 % from 8 articles, max deviation 0.96 %, and 34 values with larger stated uncertainties, kept where the fit is within them (they extend the range to 277.92 K); and the ChemSep v8.3 pure-component database critical point (545.50 K, 4830000 Pa). Between 535.03 K and the critical point the curve is held only by the critical point. The ChemSep vapour-pressure equation was not used: it deviates from the values within 1 % by +1.8 % (median, +5.3 % at most); see docs/MEASURED_CHECKS.md. Articles: Horstmann et al., J. Chem.
